title: DakshinVani — Building an Open-Source Gemma South Indian Menu Translator Agent

content.text:
We are building DakshinVani — an open-source South Indian Restaurant Menu Translator Agent powered by Google Gemma (gemma3:4b via Ollama) for the Hacktoberfest Week 2 Side Hustle challenge.
1. Inspect `data/south_indian_culinary_kb.json` and `agent/gemma_menu_agent.py`.
2. Run `python3 agent/gemma_menu_agent.py --dish "Ghee Roast Podi Masala Dosa" --langs hi,mr,fr,ja,de` and `python3 agent/gemma_menu_agent.py --dish "Mysuru Bisi Bele Bath with Kara Boondi" --langs hi,mr,fr,ja,de` in the terminal to verify how the 3-stage agent (DishDeconstructor -> CulturalBridgeMapper -> GemmaMenuCopywriter) avoids literal translation traps like "Powder Crepe" or "Hot Lentil Bath".

Inspected the culinary knowledge base (`data/south_indian_culinary_kb.json`) and the 3-stage Gemma agent architecture in `agent/gemma_menu_agent.py`. The agent pipeline comprises:
- Stage 1: DishDeconstructor (Culinary RAG & glossary trap extraction)
- Stage 2: CulturalBridgeMapper (Gastronomic lenses across Hindi, Marathi, French, Japanese, and German)
- Stage 3: GemmaMenuCopywriter (Structured native-script copywriting & dining etiquette)

Fixed Windows stdout encoding with `sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')` to support Devanagari, Tamil, Kannada, and Japanese scripts.

Executed translation runs for "Ghee Roast Podi Masala Dosa" and "Mysuru Bisi Bele Bath with Kara Boondi".

content.name: run_command
content.input: python agent/gemma_menu_agent.py --dish "Ghee Roast Podi Masala Dosa" --langs hi,mr,fr,ja,de
content.output:
Stage 1: Matched Ghee Roast Podi Masala Dosa with allergens [Dairy (A2 Cow Ghee), Sesame (in Podi), Mustard Seeds].
Stage 2: Blocked literal trap: Generic translators render 'Podi' as 'Powder/Dust' ('Clarified Butter Roasted Powder Crepe').
Stage 3: Generated culturally grounded translations:
- Hindi: देसी घी रोस्ट मिलगई पोडी मसाला डोसा
- Marathi: साजूक तूप रोस्ट पोडी (चटणी) मसाला डोसा
- French: Dosa Croustillant au Ghee, Podi Torréfié & Pommes de Terre Épicées
- Japanese: 芳醇ギーと焙煎スパイス「ポディ」のクリスピー・マサラドーサ
- German: Knuspriger Ghee-Roast Dosa mit geröstetem Podi-Gewürz & Kartoffel-Masala

content.name: run_command
content.input: python agent/gemma_menu_agent.py --dish "Mysuru Bisi Bele Bath with Kara Boondi" --langs hi,mr,fr,ja,de
content.output:
Stage 1: Matched Mysuru Bisi Bele Bath with Kara Boondi with allergens [Dairy (Ghee), Tree Nuts (Cashews & Peanuts), Mustard Seeds, Sesame/Coconut].
Stage 2: Blocked literal trap: Generic translators notoriously translate 'Bisi Bele Bath' word-for-word as 'Hot Lentil Bath'.
Stage 3: Generated culturally grounded translations:
- Hindi: मैसूरु बिसी बेले भात (कारा बूंदी और काजू तड़के के साथ) - clarifies 'भात' = cooked spiced rice, not a bath!
- Marathi: म्हैसूर बिसी बेळे भात (खमंग खारा बुंदी आणि साजूक तुपासह)
- French: Bisi Bele Bath de Mysore — Risotto Crémeux de Riz & Lentilles aux 18 Épices (clarifies: non un bain!)
- Japanese: マイソール伝統ビシ・ベレ・バーツ（18種スパイス香る南インド風濃厚豆リゾット）(「Bath」はお風呂ではなく炊き込みご飯料理)
- German: Mysuru Bisi Bele Bath — Cremiges Südindisches Linsen-Reis-Risotto mit 18 Gewürzen (kein Bad!)

content.text:
Now let's test custom dish synthesis and check the web app:
1. Run `python3 agent/gemma_menu_agent.py --dish "Rava Kesari Bath" --notes "Slow-roasted semolina pudding infused with Pampore saffron, ghee-fried cashews, and ripe pineapple" --langs hi,mr,fr,ja,de`.
2. Verify all 5 target languages (Hindi primary, Marathi, French, Japanese, and German) return generic-vs-agent comparisons, allergen tags, and cultural dining tips.

Tested custom dish synthesis for 'Rava Kesari Bath' with custom chef notes. Verified all 5 target languages return rich generic vs. agent comparisons, allergen tags (wheat gluten, ghee/dairy, tree nuts), and cultural dining tips.
Started and validated the FastAPI local web application at http://localhost:8000.
